NFL DFS Projections Week 9: DraftKings Picks, Values and Sim Plays

DraftKings main slate · Sunday, November 8 · 11 games · By Chris Spags · · Numbers as of November 8, 10:08 AM ET

Jahmyr Gibbs carries the highest SPAGS model projection on the Week 9 DraftKings main slate: 31.2 DraftKings points at $10,000. He also holds 36% of the simulated winning-lineup credit across 10,000 simulations, more than any other player on the slate, with Christian McCaffrey second at 34% for $8,000.

Behind Gibbs, the model's next four projections are Kenneth Walker III (24.9, $9,000), Christian McCaffrey (23.3, $8,000), Brock Purdy (22.1, $6,800) and Puka Nacua (22.1, $8,800). Brock Purdy returns the most per dollar of that group at 3.25 projected points per $1,000. Puka Nacua leads the wide receivers at 22.1 for $8,800, Brock Purdy leads the quarterbacks at 22.1 for $6,800, and Brock Bowers leads the tight ends at 17.5 for $7,900.

The 11-game slate runs from a 51.5-point total in DAL at IND down to 38.5 in NYG at PHI. Every projection below is a SPAGS model estimate from the November 8, 10:08 AM ET run of the Splash Play NFL model. Winning-lineup credit comes from 10,000 simulations of the contest, and tied winning entries share credit. A player's simulated floor is his 10th-percentile score and his ceiling is his 95th.

Quarterbacks: Week 9 DraftKings projections

Brock Purdy, SF vs LV ($6,800)

Brock Purdy carries the highest SPAGS model projection at the position, 22.1 DraftKings points at $6,800, the 4th-highest on the entire main slate. That is 1.0 points clear of Patrick Mahomes. The model includes 4.0 rushing attempts. The salary works out to 3.25 projected points per $1,000, 10th of 21 at the position. Across 10,000 simulations Purdy averaged 22.1 points with a simulated floor of 7.8 and a ceiling of 40.5, and he holds 8% of the simulated winning-lineup credit. San Francisco is a 9.5-point favorite at home against Las Vegas, with an implied team total of 30.5 in a game totaled at 51.5.

Patrick Mahomes, KC vs NYJ ($6,100)

Patrick Mahomes projects 2nd at the position with 21.1 DraftKings points at $6,100. The model includes 3.4 rushing attempts. The salary works out to 3.45 projected points per $1,000, 6th of 21 at the position. Across 10,000 simulations Mahomes averaged 21.2 points with a simulated floor of 8.2 and a ceiling of 38.9, and he holds 12% of the simulated winning-lineup credit. Kansas City is a 9.5-point favorite at home against the Jets, with an implied team total of 29 in a game totaled at 48.5.

Value: Drew Lock, SEA vs ARI ($4,000)

Drew Lock projects for 17.2 DraftKings points at $4,000, which works out to 4.29 points per $1,000 of salary. That is the best rate of any player priced in the cheaper half of the 21 quarterbacks the model projects for 15 or more points. The model includes 4.3 rushing attempts. Across 10,000 simulations Lock averaged 17.2 points with a simulated floor of 6.5 and a ceiling of 32.5, and he holds 10% of the simulated winning-lineup credit. Seattle is an 8.5-point favorite at home against Arizona, with an implied team total of 24 in a game totaled at 39.5.

Running backs: Week 9 DraftKings projections

Jahmyr Gibbs, DET at MIA ($10,000)

Across 10,000 simulations Gibbs averaged 31.0 points with a simulated floor of 18.5 and a ceiling of 47.2, and he holds 36% of the simulated winning-lineup credit. Detroit is a 6.5-point favorite on the road against Miami, with an implied team total of 28.5 in a game totaled at 50.5.

Kenneth Walker III, KC vs NYJ ($9,000)

Across 10,000 simulations Walker averaged 24.7 points with a simulated floor of 12.4 and a ceiling of 42.4, and he holds 15% of the simulated winning-lineup credit. Kansas City is a 9.5-point favorite at home against the Jets, with an implied team total of 29 in a game totaled at 48.5.

Christian McCaffrey, SF vs LV ($8,000)

Christian McCaffrey projects 3rd at the position with 23.3 DraftKings points at $8,000, 3rd on the main slate overall. The model gives him 14.6 carries and 5.8 targets. The salary works out to 2.92 projected points per $1,000, 2nd of 25 at the position. Across 10,000 simulations McCaffrey averaged 23.2 points with a simulated floor of 11.1 and a ceiling of 40.0, and he holds 34% of the simulated winning-lineup credit. San Francisco is a 9.5-point favorite at home against Las Vegas, with an implied team total of 30.5 in a game totaled at 51.5.

Value: Jonah Coleman, DEN at CAR ($5,300)

Jonah Coleman projects for 15.1 DraftKings points at $5,300, which works out to 2.84 points per $1,000 of salary. That is the best rate of any player priced in the cheaper half of the 25 running backs the model projects for 9 or more points. The model gives him 8.5 carries and 2.8 targets. Across 10,000 simulations Coleman averaged 15.0 points with a simulated floor of 5.0 and a ceiling of 31.1, and he holds 21% of the simulated winning-lineup credit. Denver is a 2.5-point favorite on the road against Carolina, with an implied team total of 23.5 in a game totaled at 44.5.
